acceptanceCriteria.text: Add a numbered ADR under `docs/decisions/` defining the complete four-layer deployment ladder and responsibility table.
Document exact preconditions, outputs, delegated lower route, readiness criteria, and failure boundary for each route.
State explicitly that Route 4 provisions/verifies the supported QEMU host toolchain while Lima continues to own QEMU VM lifecycle/device topology.
State explicitly how Route 2 consumes Route 1 and Route 3 consumes Route 2 so higher layers cannot silently diverge.
Define immutable release/artifact identity propagation through all four routes and a zero-manual normal deployment target.
Identify which existing decisions are preserved and which specific #600/#654/#232 QEMU-supply wording is superseded.
List current implementation gaps without claiming unimplemented behavior is already available.
Link the ADR from the deployment Epic/tracker and use it as the architecture authority for the subsequent implementation Issues.

issue.title: docs(runtime): codify the layered declarative deployment architecture
